set -e
WORK="$TMPDIR/shell_guard_verify"
rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK/proj" "$WORK/other"
cd /home/runner/work/sdlc-framework/sdlc-framework
printf 'profile: standard\n' > "$WORK/proj/sdlc.yaml"
printf 'guardrail\n' > "$WORK/proj/CLAUDE.md"

PYTHONPATH="$PWD/plugin" python3 - "$WORK/proj" "$WORK/other" <<'PYEOF'
import json, os, subprocess, sys

proj, other = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
hook = os.path.join(os.getcwd(), "plugin/hooks/shell_guard.py")

def run(command, cwd, project_dir):
    payload = {
        "hook_event_name": "PreToolUse",
        "tool_name": "Bash",
        "tool_input": {"command": command},
        "cwd": cwd,
    }
    env = {**os.environ, "CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR": project_dir}
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, hook],
        input=json.dumps(payload),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        env=env,
    )
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout.strip(), proc.stderr.strip()

print("=== 1. repro: git -C <other> status && echo x > CLAUDE.md (cwd=proj) ===")
rc, out, err = run(f"git -C {other} status && echo x > CLAUDE.md", proj, proj)
print("exit:", rc)
print("stdout:", out[:300])

print()
print("=== 2a. git -C <other> rm CLAUDE.md alone, cwd=proj (expect ALLOW) ===")
rc, out, err = run(f"git -C {other} rm CLAUDE.md", proj, proj)
print("exit:", rc)
print("stdout:", out[:300])

print()
print("=== 2b. git -C <proj> rm CLAUDE.md alone, cwd=other (expect DENY) ===")
rc, out, err = run(f"git -C {proj} rm CLAUDE.md", other, proj)
print("exit:", rc)
print("stdout:", out[:300])
PYEOF

import json
import os
import subprocess
import sys

proj = sys.argv[1]
other = sys.argv[2]
hook = sys.argv[3]


def run(command, cwd, project_dir):
    payload = dict(
        hook_event_name="PreToolUse",
        tool_name="Bash",
        tool_input=dict(command=command),
        cwd=cwd,
    )
    env = dict(os.environ)
    env["CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"] = project_dir
    proc = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, hook],
        input=json.dumps(payload),
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        env=env,
    )
    return proc.returncode, proc.stdout.strip(), proc.stderr.strip()


print("=== 1. repro: git -C other status and echo x > CLAUDE.md, cwd=proj ===")
cmd1 = "git -C " + other + " status && echo x > CLAUDE.md"
rc, out, err = run(cmd1, proj, proj)
print("exit:", rc)
print("stdout:", out[:400])
print()

print("=== 2a. git -C other rm CLAUDE.md alone, cwd=proj, expect ALLOW ===")
cmd2 = "git -C " + other + " rm CLAUDE.md"
rc, out, err = run(cmd2, proj, proj)
print("exit:", rc)
print("stdout:", out[:400])
print()

print("=== 2b. git -C proj rm CLAUDE.md alone, cwd=other, expect DENY ===")
cmd3 = "git -C " + proj + " rm CLAUDE.md"
rc, out, err = run(cmd3, other, proj)
print("exit:", rc)
print("stdout:", out[:400])
PYEOF
